title: Getting started with veryMAD
text: example uses percentage points pct_mito: 8 denotes 8%. metric flag TRUE, FALSE, NA threshold unresolved. combined flag TRUE metric flagged; otherwise NA metric remains unresolved.
code: sample_metadata <- data.frame(   sample = paste0("sample_", 1:8),   library_size = c(2.4e6, 2.5e6, 2.6e6, 2.7e6, 2.8e6, 2.6e6, 0.45e6, 2.5e6),   detected_genes = c(12000, 12500, 13100, 12800, 13400, 12600, 1500, 12300),   pct_mito = c(4, 5, 6, 5, 7, 6, 8, 29) )  qc_directions <- c(   library_size = "lower",   detected_genes = "lower",   pct_mito = "upper" )  qc_annotated <- mad_qc(   sample_metadata,   metrics = qc_directions,   transform = c(library_size = "log1p", detected_genes = "log1p"),   verbose = FALSE )  qc_annotated[, c("sample", "library_size_mad_outlier",                  "detected_genes_mad_outlier", "pct_mito_mad_outlier",                  "mad_qc_outlier")] #>     sample library_size_mad_outlier detected_genes_mad_outlier #> 1 sample_1                    FALSE                      FALSE #> 2 sample_2                    FALSE                      FALSE #> 3 sample_3                    FALSE                      FALSE #> 4 sample_4                    FALSE                      FALSE #> 5 sample_5                    FALSE                      FALSE #> 6 sample_6                    FALSE                      FALSE #> 7 sample_7                     TRUE                       TRUE #> 8 sample_8                    FALSE                      FALSE #>   pct_mito_mad_outlier mad_qc_outlier #> 1                FALSE          FALSE #> 2                FALSE          FALSE #> 3                FALSE          FALSE #> 4                FALSE          FALSE #> 5                FALSE          FALSE #> 6                FALSE          FALSE #> 7                FALSE           TRUE #> 8                 TRUE           TRUE

title: Interpreting MAD QC flags
text: Missing metric values receive NA flags. combined flag TRUE metric flagged; none flagged, NA metric flag unresolved. combined flag uses rule, flagged fraction can rise metrics included. Review per-metric counts alongside . example uses percentage points pct_mito: 8 denotes 8%. threshold report gives status, limits raw transformed scales, counts reference, flagged, unresolved observations. min_n defaults 5 non-missing reference observations per metric group. Groups size insufficient_n status; groups observed values all_missing status.
code: qc_metadata <- data.frame(   sample = paste0("sample_", 1:7),   library_size = c(2.4e6, 2.5e6, 2.6e6, 2.7e6, 2.8e6, 0.5e6, NA_real_),   detected_genes = c(12000, 12500, 13100, 12800, 13400, 1600, 12200),   pct_mito = c(4, 5, 6, 5, 7, 8, 30) )  qc_result <- mad_qc(   qc_metadata,   metrics = c(     library_size = "lower",     detected_genes = "lower",     pct_mito = "upper"   ),   output = "report",   verbose = FALSE )  qc_result$flags[, c("id", "library_size", "detected_genes",                     "pct_mito", "mad_qc_outlier")] #>   id library_size detected_genes pct_mito mad_qc_outlier #> 1  1        FALSE          FALSE    FALSE          FALSE #> 2  2        FALSE          FALSE    FALSE          FALSE #> 3  3        FALSE          FALSE    FALSE          FALSE #> 4  4        FALSE          FALSE    FALSE          FALSE #> 5  5        FALSE          FALSE    FALSE          FALSE #> 6  6         TRUE           TRUE    FALSE           TRUE #> 7  7           NA          FALSE     TRUE           TRUE transformed_result <- mad_qc(   qc_metadata,   metrics = c(library_size = "lower", pct_mito = "upper"),   transform = c(library_size = "log1p"),   output = "report",   verbose = FALSE )  transformed_result$thresholds[, c(   "metric", "direction", "transform", "lower_raw", "upper_raw",   "status", "n_used", "n_flagged", "n_unresolved" )] #>         metric direction transform lower_raw upper_raw status n_used n_flagged #> 1 library_size     lower     log1p   1961998        NA     ok      6         1 #> 2     pct_mito     upper      none        NA   10.4478     ok      7         1 #>   n_unresolved #> 1            1 #> 2            0

code: rna_metadata <- data.frame(   sample = rep(c("sample_A", "sample_B"), each = 6),   nCount_RNA = c(820, 910, 970, 1050, 1120, 100, 125, 150, 175, 190, 210, 230),   nFeature_RNA = c(430, 480, 520, 570, 610, 55, 80, 95, 100, 115, 125, 140),   percent.mt = c(5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 35, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) )  rna_report <- mad_qc(   rna_metadata,   metrics = c(     nCount_RNA = "lower",     nFeature_RNA = "lower",     percent.mt = "upper"   ),   transform = c(nCount_RNA = "log1p", nFeature_RNA = "log1p"),   output = "report",   verbose = FALSE )  rna_report$thresholds[, c("metric", "direction", "transform", "status")] #>         metric direction transform status #> 1   nCount_RNA     lower     log1p     ok #> 2 nFeature_RNA     lower     log1p     ok #> 3   percent.mt     upper      none     ok atac_metadata <- data.frame(   nCount_peaks = c(1200, 1800, 3200, 6000, 9000, 20000, 2500, 4100),   TSS.enrichment = c(0.8, 1.3, 3.0, 5.4, 8.0, 15.0, 4.1, 6.2),   nucleosome_signal = c(3.5, 2.4, 1.8, 1.4, 1.1, 0.9, 1.6, 1.3) )  atac_report <- mad_qc(   atac_metadata,   metrics = c(     nCount_peaks = "lower",     TSS.enrichment = "lower",     nucleosome_signal = "upper"   ),   transform = c(nCount_peaks = "log1p"),   output = "report",   verbose = FALSE )  atac_report$thresholds[, c("metric", "direction", "transform", "status")] #>              metric direction transform status #> 1      nCount_peaks     lower     log1p     ok #> 2    TSS.enrichment     lower      none     ok #> 3 nucleosome_signal     upper      none     ok

code: data("Bacher_param_preset", package = "SPARSim") reference <- Bacher_param_preset[["Bacher_C1"]] gene_subset <- sample(seq_along(reference$intensity), 5000L) reference_intensity <- reference$intensity[gene_subset] reference_variability <- reference$variability[gene_subset]  n_cells <- 5000L low_depth_cells <- seq_len(n_cells %/% 20L) library_size <- sample(reference$lib_size, n_cells, replace = TRUE) library_size_A <- as.integer(round(library_size * 0.01)) library_size_B <- as.integer(round(library_size_A * 0.55)) library_size_A[low_depth_cells] <- round(library_size_A[low_depth_cells] * 0.05) library_size_B[low_depth_cells] <- round(library_size_B[low_depth_cells] * 0.05) library_size_A <- pmax(1L, library_size_A) library_size_B <- pmax(1L, library_size_B)  cells_A <- paste0("library_A_cell_", seq_len(n_cells)) cells_B <- paste0("library_B_cell_", seq_len(n_cells)) parameter_A <- SPARSim::SPARSim_create_simulation_parameter(   intensity = reference_intensity,   variability = reference_variability,   library_size = library_size_A,   sample_names = cells_A,   condition_name = "library_A" ) parameter_B <- SPARSim::SPARSim_create_simulation_parameter(   intensity = reference_intensity,   variability = reference_variability,   library_size = library_size_B,   sample_names = cells_B,   condition_name = "library_B" )  simulation <- SPARSim::SPARSim_simulation(   dataset_parameter = list(library_A = parameter_A, library_B = parameter_B),   gene_expr_simulation_seed = 2718,   count_data_simulation_seed = 3141,   preserve_global_rng = TRUE ) #> Number of experimental conditions:  2  #> Number of genes:  5000  #> Number of cells:  10000  #> Setting gene expression intensity...   #> Setting gene expression variability ...   #> Simulating biological variability ...   #> Simulating technical variability ... counts <- simulation$count_matrix stopifnot(   !is.null(colnames(counts)),   length(colnames(counts)) == 2L * n_cells,   !anyDuplicated(colnames(counts)) ) library_by_cell <- c(   stats::setNames(rep("library_A", n_cells), cells_A),   stats::setNames(rep("library_B", n_cells), cells_B) ) low_depth_by_cell <- c(   stats::setNames(seq_len(n_cells) %in% low_depth_cells, cells_A),   stats::setNames(seq_len(n_cells) %in% low_depth_cells, cells_B) )  qc_metadata <- data.frame(   library = unname(library_by_cell[colnames(counts)]),   nCount_RNA = colSums(counts),   nFeature_RNA = colSums(counts > 0),   known_low_depth = unname(low_depth_by_cell[colnames(counts)]),   row.names = colnames(counts) )

Dashed lines mark estimated raw-scale limits. n counts cells finite metric pairs; rho descriptive cells independent biological replicates. cross-tabulation shows combined MAD flag recovers planted low-depth cells flags cells run. labels represent imposed depth reduction, general biological quality. code: metrics <- c(nCount_RNA = "lower", nFeature_RNA = "lower") transforms <- c(nCount_RNA = "log1p", nFeature_RNA = "log1p")  qc_annotated <- mad_qc(   qc_metadata,   metrics = metrics,   transform = transforms,   batch = qc_metadata$library,   verbose = FALSE )  qc_report <- mad_qc(   qc_metadata,   metrics = metrics,   transform = transforms,   batch = qc_metadata$library,   output = "report",   verbose = FALSE )  qc_report$thresholds[, c(   "metric", "batch", "lower_raw", "n_used", "n_flagged", "status" )] #>         metric     batch lower_raw n_used n_flagged status #> 1   nCount_RNA library_A 14657.238   5000       250     ok #> 2   nCount_RNA library_B  8060.770   5000       250     ok #> 3 nFeature_RNA library_A  1865.846   5000       301     ok #> 4 nFeature_RNA library_B  1568.392   5000       296     ok distribution_plot <- plot_mad_qc(   qc_annotated,   metrics = names(metrics),   batch = qc_metadata$library ) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none") relationship_plot <- plot_mad_qc_scatter(   qc_annotated,   x = "nCount_RNA",   y = "nFeature_RNA",   batch = qc_metadata$library,   report = qc_report ) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")  (   patchwork::wrap_plots(     distribution_plot,     relationship_plot,     ncol = 1   ) + patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "Cell-level MAD QC by library") ) with(qc_annotated, table(library, known_low_depth, mad_qc_outlier)) #> , , mad_qc_outlier = FALSE #>  #>            known_low_depth #> library     FALSE TRUE #>   library_A  4699    0 #>   library_B  4704    0 #>  #> , , mad_qc_outlier = TRUE #>  #>            known_low_depth #> library     FALSE TRUE #>   library_A    51  250 #>   library_B    46  250

title: Annotate MAD-based quality-control flags — mad_qc
text: data data frame, numeric matrix, Seurat object. Seurat, metrics must already present cell metadata. metrics non-empty named character vector unique numeric column names values "lower", "upper", "". nmads Positive finite number scaled MADs median used limit. MAD uses normal-consistency constant 1.4826. transform One method metrics named overrides; unspecified metrics use "none". Supported methods "none", "log1p", "log10". output "annotate" adds flags input; "report" returns flags, limits, settings without modifying input. min_n Positive integer minimum number non-missing reference observations per metric batch group (default 5). Smaller groups unresolved flags. zero_mad Policy group's MAD zero: "na" (default) leaves flags unresolved, "zero" sets limit median, "error" stops. overwrite Replace existing QC flag columns annotating? verbose Print summary? batch Optional non-missing vector one label per observation. Estimate separate limits within label. subset Optional non-missing logical vector selecting reference observations estimation. Apply resulting limits every row.

title: Annotate MAD-based quality-control flags — mad_qc
text: output = "annotate", returns input per-metric combined flags; matrix input returns data frame Seurat input remains Seurat object. output = "report", returns verymad_qc list containing flags, thresholds, settings. Threshold rows report limits transformed raw scales, status, used, flagged, unresolved counts. batch adds one row per metric batch.

title: Annotate MAD-based quality-control flags — mad_qc
code: qc_metadata <- data.frame(   sample = paste0("sample_", 1:6),   library_size = c(2.4e6, 2.5e6, 2.6e6, 2.7e6, 0.5e6, 2.5e6),   pct_mito = c(4, 5, 6, 5, 7, 30) ) annotated <- mad_qc(   qc_metadata,   metrics = c(library_size = "lower", pct_mito = "upper"),   verbose = FALSE ) annotated[, c("sample", "mad_qc_outlier")] #>     sample mad_qc_outlier #> 1 sample_1          FALSE #> 2 sample_2          FALSE #> 3 sample_3          FALSE #> 4 sample_4          FALSE #> 5 sample_5           TRUE #> 6 sample_6           TRUE  report <- mad_qc(   qc_metadata,   metrics = c(library_size = "lower", pct_mito = "upper"),   output = "report",   verbose = FALSE ) report$thresholds[, c("metric", "n_used", "n_flagged", "n_unresolved")] #>         metric n_used n_flagged n_unresolved #> 1 library_size      6         1            0 #> 2     pct_mito      6         1            0

title: Center and scale with the median and MAD — mad_scale
text: x Numeric vector, matrix, data frame numeric columns. center Subtract median vector matrix margin? scale Divide vector matrix margin MAD? constant Positive consistency constant applied MAD. default, 1.4826, makes consistent standard deviation normal distribution. na_rm Omit missing values estimating medians MADs. Missing input values remain missing result. zero_mad Policy zero MAD scale = TRUE: "na" returns NA affected vector margin, "zero" uses unit denominator, "error" stops. Centered results "zero" deviations median without MAD scaling. margin Matrix margin: 1 "rows" operates rows; 2 "columns" operates columns. Ignored vectors.
